title: AutoSwap
description: Automatic tool, weapon, armor and totem swapping — equips the right item, auto-replaces broken gear, refills depleted stacks, and deploys your elytra on a double jump. Fully client-side.
body:
[![JOIN OUR DISCORD](https://img.shields.io/badge/JOIN%20OUR%20DISCORD-5865F2?style=for-the-badge&logo=discord&logoColor=white)](https://discord.gg/HTkn94BXmA) [![CurseForge](https://img.shields.io/badge/CURSEFORGE-F16436?style=for-the-badge&logo=curseforge&logoColor=white)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/auto-swap)

Client-side mod that automates inventory management and equipment swapping during gameplay. Detects durability loss, empty item stacks, and block-breaking actions to equip the correct items from your inventory automatically.

![Configuration](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1a2838d420c2b0fe26ddf6f7c3c5df8f03c73868.png)

**Client-side only** (no server installation required). **Fully compatible with singleplayer**.

**Free to use in any modpack** — public or private, no permission needed.

## **What it does**
- **Smart Tool Selection** — switches to the most efficient tool the moment you start mining, and won't replace a tool that's already the right type.
- **Auto Weapon on Attack** — optionally draws your best sword the instant you start hitting a mob. Disable it and AutoSwap will never swap off your weapon while a mob is in your crosshair.
- **Gear Replacement** — automatically equips a matching tool, weapon, or armor piece when the currently equipped one breaks.
- **Offhand Replenishment** — refills your off-hand when the held item runs out. Add a Totem of Undying, shield, or any item via the built-in **item picker** or by item ID.
- **Stack Refills** — refills the active hotbar slot with identical blocks or torches when the current stack is depleted.
- **Double-Jump Elytra** — equips an elytra from your inventory on double jump, and swaps your chestplate back on landing.
- **Restore After Auto-Tool** — puts the item you were holding back in your hand once you stop mining.

## **Configuration**
All features are fully modular and can be toggled individually through the in-game settings screen, the config file, or via keybinds under Controls → AutoSwap.

## **Details**
- Client-side only.
- All settings are stored locally in your game config folder.
- Translated into 10 languages — English and Russian are complete; other locales are in progress.
